question: How is the production of GHCN-Daily funded, were that funding, its team or the data sources it depends on threatened between January 2025 and November 2026, and has news from 2024 to 2026 named them?

What threats did GHCN-Daily, its products and its team face between January 2025 and November 2026?
Are its US source networks (COOP, ASOS, CoCoRaHS, USCRN, SNOTEL/SCAN, RAWS) at risk?
Are its non-US sources (WMO exchange through GTS/WIS2, national services, ECA&D, Environment Canada) at risk?
